content.title: About
content.content: EAS Soy Protein Powder (item 5485) is a high‑quality nutritional mix containing soy protein isolate, vitamins and minerals. It is formulated to support muscle growth, post‑workout recovery and to provide the body with essential nutrients.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Contains more than 90 % pure soy protein.
Enriched with B‑vitamins, vitamin D and calcium for metabolism and bone health.
Free from lactose, gluten and artificial colourings.
Produced using cold‑extraction technology, preserving protein bioactivity.

items.title: High protein content
items.content: Helps repair and build muscle tissue after physical activity.

items.title: Low fat level
items.content: Supports calorie‑controlled diets, useful for weight management.

items.title: Rich in vitamins and minerals
items.content: B‑vitamins, D and calcium aid energy metabolism, bone strength and immunity.

items.title: Cardiovascular support
items.content: Soy protein contains isoflavones that may help maintain healthy cholesterol levels.

items.title: Convenient to use
items.content: Easily dissolves in water, milk or plant‑based drinks for a quick nutritious shake.

items.title: Soy allergy
items.content: Individuals allergic to soy may experience reactions up to anaphylaxis.

items.title: Phytoestrogens
items.content: Soy isoflavones have mild estrogenic activity; consult a doctor if you have hormonal disorders.

items.title: Excessive protein intake
items.content: Very high protein consumption can strain the kidneys, especially in people with chronic kidney disease.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Mix 30 g of powder with 250–300 ml of water, milk or a plant‑based beverage. It can also be added to smoothies, oatmeal or baked goods to boost protein content.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place in a tightly sealed container. For long‑term storage, keep refrigerated to prevent moisture absorption.
